summary: Testing blocked by critical onboarding modal issue. The onboarding modal appears repeatedly and cannot be dismissed, preventing access to all app features including Instrum Studio DAW, Library, Settings, and other sections. Brief access to Beat Maker page confirmed app is functional underneath.

critical_bugs.issue: Onboarding modal cannot be dismissed and reappears repeatedly, blocking all app functionality
critical_bugs.details: Modal appears on page load and after any navigation attempt. Attempted fixes: (1) Clicking 'Skip' button - no effect or button not found, (2) Setting localStorage 'treesh_onboarded' flag - ignored on reload, (3) Pressing Escape key - no effect, (4) Removing modal DOM elements - modal regenerates, (5) Setting state.modal=null - no effect. Modal intercepts all pointer events preventing interaction with underlying app.
critical_bugs.impact: Completely blocks testing of all requested features: DAW stem editing, select/copy/paste, marquee selection, custom song likes, music manager, lyric studio tips, backdrops studio

critical_bugs.issue: Onboarding completion state not persisting across page reloads or navigation
critical_bugs.details: Even after setting localStorage flags (treesh_onboarded, treesh_user), the onboarding modal reappears on page reload. The app does not respect the onboarding completion state.

critical_bugs.issue: Navigation to 'instrum' triggers onboarding modal to reappear
critical_bugs.details: Calling navigate('instrum') causes the onboarding modal to show again even if it was previously dismissed. This prevents access to the Studios section.

observations.details: Successfully accessed Beat Maker page for ~2 seconds before onboarding modal reappeared. Observed: 16-step sequencer grid, multiple instrument tracks (Kick, Snare, Clap, Closed Hat, Open Hat, Tom, 808 Bass, Synth, Chord, Pluck), transport controls, BPM control, preset buttons (Boom Bap, Trap, House, Lo-Fi, Afrobeat, Pop, Drill, Drum & Bass), swing and master volume sliders. UI appears well-designed and functional.
App loads successfully with boot splash screen showing 'TREESH' logo, animated equalizer, and 'MUSIC TO LIVE FOR' tagline. Splash screen transitions smoothly.

success_percentage.frontend: 0% - No features could be tested due to onboarding modal blocker

action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Fix onboarding modal dismissal logic. The modal cannot be dismissed and blocks all app functionality. Required fixes: (1) Ensure 'Skip' button properly closes modal and sets persistent flag, (2) Respect localStorage onboarding completion state on page load, (3) Prevent modal from reappearing after dismissal, (4) Ensure modal does not block navigation to Studios/Instrum, (5) Add data-testid attributes to onboarding elements for reliable testing (e.g., data-testid='onboarding-skip', data-testid='onboarding-continue'). Once fixed, all 8 feature tests can proceed: DAW stem editing, select/copy/paste/FX, marquee selection, DAW regression, custom song likes, music manager cleanup, lyric studio tips, and backdrops studio.
